side_price_rule: FINAL-NO buys NO at cost 100 - yes_bid (NEVER 100 - yes_ask); winner-YES buys YES at yes_ask

a_oracle.limitation: Only the top-40 'capturable_markets_detail' of out/edge_sizing_v2.json survives on disk; the full 140-market Stage-1 set is absent.  The subset test is therefore (i) a price-join reproduction on those 40 rungs from my own fresh pull, and (ii) the Stage-1 capturable test re-derived on the same candles for every priced fire whose side won and whose entry is inside the oracle's final 60 min.

b_no_lookahead.method: for every distinct signal index k0 of every event: re-run the detector on obs[:k0+1] and on the full day with all later obs replaced by +50F / -50F from the k0 temperature; all decisions at indices <= k0 must be identical (assert; the script aborts otherwise)

c_monotonic_tz.close_time_assertion: close_time == LST midnight ending the event date (or 60 s earlier) for every event; skips: {}

schema.part1_fires: per rung+flavor: cells{cellkey:[k,obs_ts,sig_ts,E,[arm L0,arm L10,arm L20]]}; arm = ['P',entry_candle_end_ts,cost_c,fee_c,entry_volume,pnl_c] | ['U',reason]; NO side: cost=100-yes_bid
schema.part2_days: per signalling city-day: rungs[{ticker,side,flavor,dist,result,arms[L0,L10,L20]}]; winner side YES cost=yes_ask, losers side NO cost=100-yes_bid
schema.recompute: cost/fee/pnl are fully determined by the arm fields and the official result; signal fields are reproducible from cache/finality_no/A/obs via `finality_no_A.py signals`.
